adopted: A1. Absence-is-the-signal as mesh convention: unadmitted links removed, never dimmed. (Reinforces existing rule; cite this file as the reference implementation.)
A2. Rotating blind-spot HUD pattern: any mandala panel making a claim (Math card, Gaven card) cycles its own stated limitations. Implement as a shared component.
A3. window.X honest API standard: every major component exposes {params, state(), blindSpots}. Our PrototypeProof pattern already does this; adopt the naming discipline.
A4. Refusal-as-absence for Gaven's gate: refusals logged in the Evidence Ledger, never decorated in the scene. (The ledger implementation comes from the witness import.)
A5. Per-frame procedural displacement technique (standing-wave icosphere, no textures) as a candidate treatment for the white-dwarf core surface.

rejected: R1. The decorative gate: a labeled gate that gates nothing. Rejected as a pattern — Gaven's gate is real (credential/tether/expiry); decorative gates would dilute it.
R2. '515 Hz' geometry as physical claim: keep the wave as geometric metaphor, the tone as the only real 515 Hz.
R3. The dual-condition link test (eta>=0.5 && onFreq): redundant; eta>=0.5 with Q=14 already implies the frequency window. Single threshold only.
R4. The outlier construction (+17 Hz): does not achieve its stated severing intent. Any future off-frequency demo must be verified against the actual threshold.

right_about: Real procedural geometry: hand-written icosphere subdivision (correct midpoint-cache algorithm), per-frame vertex displacement in the shader, no textures, no pre-baked maps, no library. This is MEDUSA-compliant — equation-driven, readable.
Honest borrowing: states exactly what it takes from the RESONANCE mandala (Fibonacci layout, Lorentzian eta verbatim, 0.500 threshold, palette) and claims no invention over it.
'Absence is the signal': severed links are removed, not dimmed. A real honesty convention — matches our standing rule that unadmitted edges must be absent, not decorative.
Rotating blind-spot HUD: cycles its own stated limitations every 7s, including 'I wrote this shader without running it' — the honesty convention Nathan values, implemented as UI.

Failure discipline: 'failing paths printed in the same font as passing paths'; WebGL-unavailable path refuses a static fallback ('a static fallback would be a different painting, and I will not pretend otherwise'). Matches our loud-failure law.
window.Carrier honest API: exposes seed, threshold, Q, per-body eta/linked state, blind spots. Self-auditable component.
Mobile/accessibility care: DPR cap, pointer + pinch + wheel input, reduced-motion, ARIA labels, audio opt-in only.
wrong_about: The 'single gate that refuses anything not traceable to a named language' is decorative: no gate logic exists in the code. Links draw from the origin to linked bodies; nothing is ever presented to a gate, nothing is refused. The gate is a comment and a line-origin, not a mechanism. (Same overstatement in witness.html's CSS gate.)

The outlier design fails its own stated intent: bodies i=6 (forgeweave) and i=21 (Glass) get +17 Hz 'to sever'. But eta(532,515,Q=14)=0.539 >= 0.5 and |532-515|=17 < 20, so forgeweave stays LINKED. Only Glass actually severs. The severing logic was not analyzed against its own threshold — and eta>=0.5 already implies |f-515|<=18.4<20, making the '&& b.onFreq' condition redundant.

'515 Hz carrier' as physics: the only real 515 Hz in the file is the audio sine. The wave coefficients (uTime*1.4, 0.9, 0.6) are arbitrary animation speeds. The file admits this in blind spot (a), but the title and copy still trade on the number. Import the geometry, never the claim.
'A 3D painting of a carrier is the carrier itself' — art-copy, not doctrine. Do not adopt as a technical claim.
Minor: 'dim' color defined but unused; bodies are gold-or-alarm only.

what_it_is: A zero-dependency WebGL painting: an icosphere displaced per-frame by a standing-wave vertex shader (the '515 Hz carrier'), 28 language bodies on a Fibonacci sphere, links drawn only when Lorentzian eta >= 0.5, off-frequency bodies dimmed with links removed. No CDN, no textures, seeded RNG, loud failure paths.
